mapper.sql: SELECT c.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_NAME, c.DESCRIPTION, c.CATEGORY_COLOR, c.OWNER_USERNAME, u.NAME AS OWNER_NAME, c.SORT_ORDER, c.USE_YN, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CATEGORY_PROPERTY WHERE CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID) AS PROPERTY_COUNT, c.CREATED_AT, c.CREATED_BY, c.UPDATED_AT, c.UPDATED_BY FROM TB_CATEGORY c LEFT JOIN TB_USER u ON c.OWNER_USERNAME = u.USERNAME
mapper.select: WHERE c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND c.CATEGORY_ID IN ( SELECT cs.CATEGORY_ID FROM TB_CATEGORY_SHARE cs WHERE cs.SHARE_TYPE = 'USER' AND cs.SHARE_TARGET = #{username} ) ORDER BY c.SORT_ORDER, c.CATEGORY_NAME

WHERE c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND c.CATEGORY_ID IN ( SELECT cs.CATEGORY_ID FROM TB_CATEGORY_SHARE cs WHERE cs.SHARE_TYPE = 'DEPARTMENT' AND cs.SHARE_TARGET = #{deptCode} ) ORDER BY c.SORT_ORDER, c.CATEGORY_NAME

WHERE c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND ( c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} OR c.CATEGORY_ID IN ( SELECT cs.CATEGORY_ID FROM TB_CATEGORY_SHARE cs WHERE (cs.SHARE_TYPE = 'USER' AND cs.SHARE_TARGET = #{username}) OR (cs.SHARE_TYPE = 'DEPARTMENT' AND cs.SHARE_TARGET = #{deptCode}) ) ) ORDER BY c.OWNER_USERNAME = #{username} DESC, c.SORT_ORDER, c.CATEGORY_NAME
WHERE c.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY c.SORT_ORDER, c.CATEGORY_NAME

c.USE_YN = #{useYn}
ORDER BY c.USE_YN DESC, c.SORT_ORDER, c.CATEGORY_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CATEGORY ( CATEGORY_CODE, CATEGORY_NAME, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY_COLOR, OWNER_USERNAME, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{categoryCode}, #{categoryName}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{categoryColor}, '#6B7280'), #{ownerUsername}, #{sortOrder}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CATEGORY SET CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode}, CATEGORY_NAME = #{categoryName}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, CATEGORY_COLOR = #{categoryColor}, SORT_ORDER = #{sortOrder}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
UPDATE TB_CATEGORY SET USE_YN = 'N', UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
